messages:
Maria (PM): FYI ACME just signed — they need private deploy with HSM keys + a p95 latency SLA of 99.9%. Staging target: end of quarter.
Ajay (Runtime Eng): Wow, HSM + p95 SLA in a private stack is tight. Do we have a dedicated GPU slot in their region?
Kevin (Infra): Short answer: not unless we take a prewarm slot from Beacon. We have two prewarm slots free but both were promised to Beacon's pilot.
Maria (PM): Can ACME accept a staggered onramp? They'd do staging by EoQ and then a +6wk full ramp if we do a canary.
Elaine (Security): HSM/KMS requires attestation and a light pen test. Rough timeline: attestation + config ~10 business days, pen test ~5 days after infra is live. Also need key policy signed before prod.
Ajay (Runtime Eng): From runtime: items are (1) private control plane HSM plugin config, (2) KV prefix caching & quantization tuning to hit p95, (3) a hosted-variant fallback. I can scope (1)+(3) across 2 sprints if infra slot is available.
Kevin (Infra): If we reassign one prewarm slot, infra (VPC peering, NATs, routes) can be ready in ~7 days. That forces Beacon to accept a 2-week slip or get burst capacity instead.
Maria (PM): I'll talk to Beacon PM about shifting a slot. For ACME can we propose canary sequencing: 10% traffic 48h -> 50% 72h -> 100%? That gives time for sec checks.
Ajay (Runtime Eng): Canary OK. We need tracing + token-level telemetry + prompt-set quality checks enabled for each stage. Also will add KV caching early in the rollout.
Elaine (Security): Gating criteria: (a) HSM attestation completed, (b) pen test returns no critical/major findings, (c) canary metrics: error_rate <0.5% and p95 within SLA for 48h.
Maria (PM): I'll draft the launch criteria and an amendment to the contract. Who owns the rollout playbook?
Ajay (Runtime Eng): I'll own the rollout playbook + runbook and include fallback routing. Draft canary routing snippet: ```yaml
canary:
  - stage: initial
    percent: 10
    duration: 48h
  - stage: ramp
    percent: 50
    duration: 72h
rollback_on:
  - error_rate_pct: 0.5
  - p95_latency_delta_pct: 15
```
Kevin (Infra): I'll own infra provisioning & VPC peering. Need Maria to confirm region + whether to transfer the prewarm slot by EOD Tue.
Elaine (Security): Ping me when infra is live and I'll book attestation and pen test windows.
Maria (PM): Action list: (1) Maria -> negotiate Beacon slot or confirm transfer by EOD Tue; (2) Kevin -> prepare infra template once slot confirmed; (3) Ajay -> draft playbook + telemetry hooks by next Wed; (4) Elaine -> schedule attestation/pen test. I'll flag as "customer-driven - high" on the initiative board.
Ajay (Runtime Eng): One more runtime ask: enable KV prefix cache and early aggregation to stabilize p95 during canary. Adding that to the playbook.
Kevin (Infra): Added network checklist items: KMS endpoints, routing to HSM, NAT sizing for burst traffic.
ops-bot: Reminder: add ticket "ACME private pilot" to launch-lane board. Template at /boards/launch-lane/ACME-private-pilot.
Maria (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll post follow-up with the Beacon PM thread and update the initiative card. :thumbsup:
